title: Evia Pulse Review Snapshots
details: When a completed Milos review is received, Evia now saves a permanent local Review Snapshot before the previous Coach period closes
Each snapshot keeps the review date and summary, next review date, agreed targets, course position, OTJ or GLH, evidence counts, Evia usage, EPA practice, confidence and wellbeing check-in summary
Evia Pulse now includes Review history so the learner can reopen previous review checkpoints
The existing v234 Milos return flow still updates the next review date and agreed targets and then starts the next Coach period
No learner identity, contact details, media files or signatures are added to the QR exchange
summary: Evia v235 turns every completed Milos review into a permanent local Pulse Review Snapshot, preserving the learner's position at that exact review checkpoint before the next period begins.
changes: Save Review Snapshot before review-period closure
Add Review history to Evia Pulse
Store course, learning, evidence, usage, EPA, confidence and wellbeing position
Keep Milos review summary, next date and targets with the snapshot
